program.source:
"""Scorer: pay the amount with coins 1, 5, 10, 25 - fewer coins, higher score."""
import sys

amount = int(open(sys.argv[1]).read().split()[0])
best = int(open(sys.argv[3]).read().split()[0])
try:
    tokens = list(map(int, open(sys.argv[2]).read().split()))
except ValueError:
    print(0)
    sys.exit(0)
if not tokens or tokens[0] != len(tokens) - 1 or tokens[0] < 1:
    print(0)
    sys.exit(0)
coins = tokens[1:]
if any(c not in (1, 5, 10, 25) for c in coins) or sum(coins) != amount:
    print(0)
    sys.exit(0)
print(100 * best // len(coins))
